assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent foreground wall prop for an illustrated 2D Japanese fantasy platform game. Reference image: ancient angel ruins scene, match its detailed painterly stone materials, ivory gray weathered masonry, antique gold details, ivy and moss. Primary request: one tall ruined angel tower wall/pillar section, seen straight on, architectural front elevation with no perspective. Entire tall wall visible including top broken crown and grounded rubble foot, roughly 3:1 height to width, centered on canvas, transparent background. Interlocking aged alabaster blocks with deep cracks, a narrow inset wing/feather relief, broken gold ring accents, ragged eroded silhouette with trailing ivy. Broad massive masonry through central section so it reads as solid wall, no large holes, no flat graphic lines. Side-lit soft daylight, muted cool ivory and moss greens so a small orange hero remains readable in front. Transparent background with clean natural alpha, no sky, no scenery or ground plane, no characters, no text, no UI, no watermark. Do not crop wall crown or rubble.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent foreground stone wall prop for an illustrated 2D Japanese fantasy metroidvania. Reference image is the existing cult cave, match its detailed painted damp charcoal basalt, ancient Japanese occult shrine mood and low warm candle reflections. Primary request: one tall narrow solid cave wall section viewed straight on, roughly 3:1 height-to-width, entire object visible with ragged cracked edges and grounded rubble base. Dense layered dark slate/black stone blocks and natural rock strata, subtle moss roots, dim violet mineral seams, a few old frayed paper talismans on a thin rope near the top. Solid central rock mass, carved weathered rock texture, no big holes, no doors, no people. Keep low contrast internally so orange hero and bright spell telegraphs remain clear. Transparent background alpha, no backdrop or floor plane, no floating ornamental assets, no fire particles, no text, no watermark. Wall crown and foot must fit completely inside canvas.
